lines.style: Speak English as a Japanese beginner who learned it from textbooks: katakana-like vowels added after consonants, flat syllable-by-syllable timing, every syllable equally stressed. Keep it natural, not a caricature. Say "right" with a clear English r sound, exactly as written (it is the learner's mistake for "light"). Brisk, no pauses, the whole line in about one and a half seconds.
